content: React Router has 3 modes: Declarative (BrowserRouter, basic), Data (createBrowserRouter+RouterProvider, adds loaders/actions, recommended for route-1:1 data needs), Framework (SSR/file routing, full-stack). For a client-only SPA with list+detail routes, Data mode with loaders is recommended over useEffect fetching. Registry: react-router (unified package, not react-router-dom) latest v7 line is 7.18.1; v8.2.0 exists (released 2026-06-17) but raises baseline to Node 22.22+/Vite 7+ and removes react-router-dom -- stay on 7.x for this phase to match already-vetted STACK.md compatibility notes.
